meta.title: Troublemakers
meta.description: A sweeping staff accompanies a fine blade, as the reckless fall into the trap that is laid.

units.rawText: Next to gate 6 of the event grounds.
units.displayText: Next to gate 6 of the event grounds.

spans.text: Next to gate 6 of the event grounds.

units.rawText: Horizon lies in the corner hogtied. Florence and Kuro stand next to her as the former brandishes a syringe and the latter leverages her camera in glee.
units.displayText: Horizon lies in the corner hogtied. Florence and Kuro stand next to her as the former brandishes a syringe and the latter leverages her camera in glee.

spans.text: Horizon lies in the corner hogtied. Florence and Kuro stand next to her as the former brandishes a syringe and the latter leverages her camera in glee.

units.rawText: We won't have to see each other for much longer now. Do you mind staying quiet?
units.displayText: We won't have to see each other for much longer now. Do you mind staying quiet?

spans.text: We won't have to see each other for much longer now. Do you mind staying quiet?

units.rawText: ...I'm still in charge of the festival; how am I to ignore breaking and entering? If I were you, I'd go hand myself to Evelyn.
units.displayText: ...I'm still in charge of the festival; how am I to ignore breaking and entering? If I were you, I'd go hand myself to Evelyn.

spans.text: ...I'm still in charge of the festival; how am I to ignore breaking and entering? If I were you, I'd go hand myself to Evelyn.

units.rawText: Why must you force my hand so, Horizon? Do you know what I hold in my hands here?
units.displayText: Why must you force my hand so, Horizon? Do you know what I hold in my hands here?

spans.text: Why must you force my hand so, Horizon? Do you know what I hold in my hands here?

units.rawText: This'll turn up the sensory systems of an agent a thou~sand~fold!
units.displayText: This'll turn up the sensory systems of an agent a thou~sand~fold!

spans.text: This'll turn up the sensory systems of an agent a thou~sand~fold!

units.rawText: Wow! And you carry this stuff around with you.
units.displayText: Wow! And you carry this stuff around with you.

spans.text: Wow! And you carry this stuff around with you.

units.rawText: Hold up; let me get the camera rolling. It would be a shame not to record something this exciting.
units.displayText: Hold up; let me get the camera rolling. It would be a shame not to record something this exciting.

spans.text: Hold up; let me get the camera rolling. It would be a shame not to record something this exciting.

units.rawText: Wha... what are you going to do?
units.displayText: Wha... what are you going to do?

spans.text: Wha... what are you going to do?

units.rawText: If you don't listen, I'll just inject this little beauty into your neural systems, and then~
units.displayText: If you don't listen, I'll just inject this little beauty into your neural systems, and then~

spans.text: If you don't listen, I'll just inject this little beauty into your neural systems, and then~

units.rawText: An-and then?
units.displayText: An-and then?

spans.text: An-and then?

units.rawText: Then? Why, of course... hehehe...
units.displayText: Then? Why, of course... hehehe...

spans.text: Then? Why, of course... hehehe...

units.rawText: Even if you do that, I'll...
units.displayText: Even if you do that, I'll...

spans.text: Even if you do that, I'll...

units.rawText: See, that's not for you to decide. Do you know how many disobedient individuals in the Medical Department have been done in by this little concoction?
units.displayText: See, that's not for you to decide. Do you know how many disobedient individuals in the Medical Department have been done in by this little concoction?

spans.text: See, that's not for you to decide. Do you know how many disobedient individuals in the Medical Department have been done in by this little concoction?

units.rawText: Sensitivity multiplied by 1000, combined with a pinky toe slammed into a table. Hasn't failed once~
units.displayText: Sensitivity multiplied by 1000, combined with a pinky toe slammed into a table. Hasn't failed once~

spans.text: Sensitivity multiplied by 1000, combined with a pinky toe slammed into a table. Hasn't failed once~

units.rawText: ...You monster!
units.displayText: ...You monster!

spans.text: ...You monster!

units.rawText: Can't be helped. With things as they are, this is my only option. I hope you don't come to hate me, Miss Horizon.
units.displayText: Can't be helped. With things as they are, this is my only option. I hope you don't come to hate me, Miss Horizon.

spans.text: Can't be helped. With things as they are, this is my only option. I hope you don't come to hate me, Miss Horizon.

units.rawText: <size=40>Save—unf!</size>
units.displayText: Save—unf!

spans.text: Save—unf!

units.rawText: Florence swiftly covered Horizon's mouth, thoroughly emptying the syringe in her hands.
units.displayText: Florence swiftly covered Horizon's mouth, thoroughly emptying the syringe in her hands.

spans.text: Florence swiftly covered Horizon's mouth, thoroughly emptying the syringe in her hands.

units.rawText: Whew~you really hit her with that?
units.displayText: Whew~you really hit her with that?

spans.text: Whew~you really hit her with that?

units.rawText: Just a little bit of the magic touch to put her to sleep. If I really have something to increase sensitivity, I'd naturally use it for something more interesting~
units.displayText: Just a little bit of the magic touch to put her to sleep. If I really have something to increase sensitivity, I'd naturally use it for something more interesting~

spans.text: Just a little bit of the magic touch to put her to sleep. If I really have something to increase sensitivity, I'd naturally use it for something more interesting~

units.rawText: CLANG—
units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.rawText: As the two speak, a wispy metallic ringing fills the air.
units.displayText: As the two speak, a wispy metallic ringing fills the air.

spans.text: As the two speak, a wispy metallic ringing fills the air.

units.rawText: Ephemeral whispers of footsteps and voices closely follow.
units.displayText: Ephemeral whispers of footsteps and voices closely follow.

spans.text: Ephemeral whispers of footsteps and voices closely follow.

units.rawText: Do you feel it, too?
units.displayText: Do you feel it, too?

spans.text: Do you feel it, too?

units.rawText: Yes... this sound... and this presence, as if a mighty foe is upon me once more...
units.displayText: Yes... this sound... and this presence, as if a mighty foe is upon me once more...

spans.text: Yes... this sound... and this presence, as if a mighty foe is upon me once more...

units.rawText: Oh? It would appear there are guests. Come, let's leave.
units.displayText: Oh? It would appear there are guests. Come, let's leave.

spans.text: Oh? It would appear there are guests. Come, let's leave.

units.rawText: No, wait! Judging from the sound, they're not staff.
units.displayText: No, wait! Judging from the sound, they're not staff.

spans.text: No, wait! Judging from the sound, they're not staff.

units.rawText: Some people your post tricked?
units.displayText: Some people your post tricked?

spans.text: Some people your post tricked?

units.rawText: Exactly. Hehe, I've got an idea...
units.displayText: Exactly. Hehe, I've got an idea...

spans.text: Exactly. Hehe, I've got an idea...

units.rawText: Kuro jogs over to the road sign by the path, smacking it one way and kicking it the other, forcefully twisting it around.
units.displayText: Kuro jogs over to the road sign by the path, smacking it one way and kicking it the other, forcefully twisting it around.

spans.text: Kuro jogs over to the road sign by the path, smacking it one way and kicking it the other, forcefully twisting it around.

units.rawText: This disguise of yours seems a bit... clumsy and amateurish, no?
units.displayText: This disguise of yours seems a bit... clumsy and amateurish, no?

spans.text: This disguise of yours seems a bit... clumsy and amateurish, no?

units.rawText: What matters is not the expertise, it's whether if it works. With how firmly they believe in the contents of the post, they won't even begin to doubt it!
units.displayText: What matters is not the expertise, it's whether if it works. With how firmly they believe in the contents of the post, they won't even begin to doubt it!

spans.text: What matters is not the expertise, it's whether if it works. With how firmly they believe in the contents of the post, they won't even begin to doubt it!

units.rawText: Now, if we then put Horizon where the road sign leads, and then head for the commercial district...
units.displayText: Now, if we then put Horizon where the road sign leads, and then head for the commercial district...

spans.text: Now, if we then put Horizon where the road sign leads, and then head for the commercial district...

units.rawText: Hehehe, I understand. Not only can you lead them away, but we can use them as scapegoats for what we have done. As expected of Kuro.
units.displayText: Hehehe, I understand. Not only can you lead them away, but we can use them as scapegoats for what we have done. As expected of Kuro.

spans.text: Hehehe, I understand. Not only can you lead them away, but we can use them as scapegoats for what we have done. As expected of Kuro.

units.rawText: See, that's it. Make them brawl it out with the people looking for us, and we'll be able to do whatever we want.
units.displayText: See, that's it. Make them brawl it out with the people looking for us, and we'll be able to do whatever we want.

spans.text: See, that's it. Make them brawl it out with the people looking for us, and we'll be able to do whatever we want.

units.rawText: An intriguing plan, to be sure. Allow me to lend you a hand.
units.displayText: An intriguing plan, to be sure. Allow me to lend you a hand.

spans.text: An intriguing plan, to be sure. Allow me to lend you a hand.

units.rawText: With this compound that'll make the body temporarily stiff, let me think of a pose I'll place little Horizon here in... hehehe...
units.displayText: With this compound that'll make the body temporarily stiff, let me think of a pose I'll place little Horizon here in... hehehe...

spans.text: With this compound that'll make the body temporarily stiff, let me think of a pose I'll place little Horizon here in... hehehe...
